name: dot-pattern
title: Dot Pattern
description: A full-frame grid of small dots, static or softly twinkling (glow), for UI and data backdrops; mask it to fade at the edges.

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.dotPattern(q(".mw-dot-pattern"), tl, 0, { width: 32, height: 32, cx: 2, cy: 2, cr: 3, glow: true, color: "rgba(196,181,253,0.9)", hold: 7 });

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: Static unless glow is on. Thousands of dots: for glow keep the spacing large (24 px or more) on a full HD frame.
moworks.titleVi: Nền lưới chấm, có thể lấp lánh
